en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a side view of an early steam locomotive on rails. The engine has a boxy side‑tank design, large driving wheels, a tall chimney, domes on the boiler, and an enclosed cab with arched windows. The background is blank, emphasizing the locomotive as a studio or catalogue style photograph. Small printed text and numbers appear in the bottom corners.
